_comment: CTX-1 quality fixture (ADR-0024 decision 8). 24 docs, 4 topics x 6, topic pairs deployment<->database and security<->onboarding. Per topic: docs 1-3 share the topic's query terms but their vectors lean toward the partner topic (lexically reachable, semantically confusable — the dense leg's blind spot); docs 4-6 are paraphrases with clean topic vectors (semantically reachable only — the sparse leg's blind spot). Each leg alone plateaus near 0.5 recall; fusion must recover both halves. topic_mix drives the synthetic vector geometry in CI; the live-TEI harness embeds `content` instead.

docs.content: Canary deployment rollout steps: shift five percent of traffic, watch error budget, then promote the release.
Rollback procedure for a failed deployment: repoint the release ref and drain the bad pods.
Deployment freeze windows are announced in the release calendar before every quarter close.
Shipping a build safely means gradual exposure, health watching, and a fast path back to the previous version.
When a bad artifact reaches production, repoint to the last good image and let the fleet converge.
Progressive traffic shifting with automated abort keeps customer impact small when shipping changes.
Autovacuum tuning for large tables: raise the cost limit and lower scale factor on hot relations.
Index bloat on the orders table is checked weekly; reindex concurrently when it passes thirty percent.
Connection pool sizing for the analytics database follows cores times two plus spindles.
Slow reads usually trace back to relation growth outpacing the planner statistics refresh cadence.
Nightly storage jobs reclaim dead rows so reads stay predictable under churn.
Keeping too many client sessions open exhausts server slots; size the shared entry points deliberately.
Secret rotation runbook: rotate the vault credentials quarterly and audit every access grant.
Incident response for a leaked secret: revoke, rotate, then trace the exposure window in the audit log.
Access reviews for the security perimeter run monthly against the compliance register.
Anything that reaches a paste site must be invalidated immediately and its blast radius mapped.
Quarterly key ceremonies replace signing material before certificates approach expiry.
Least privilege pruning removes unused grants so dormant accounts cannot become entry points.
New engineer onboarding checklist: laptop setup, repository permissions, and the first-week buddy plan.
Onboarding buddies review the starter project with the new engineer at the end of week two.
The onboarding portal tracks equipment, badges, and account provisioning for every new hire.
A newcomer's first fortnight covers tooling, codebase tours, and a small starter change shipped with a mentor.
Getting a fresh teammate productive means pairing early and keeping the setup guide current.
Mentors introduce fresh colleagues to the review culture during their first shipped change.
